Package com.elioo.healthcare.llm.model

Record Class LlmRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.elioo.healthcare.llm.model.LlmRequest
Record Components:
userPrompt - The user's prompt
systemPrompt - System instructions (optional)
modelId - Provider model identifier (optional; provider default when null)
maxTokens - Maximum tokens to generate (optional)
temperature - Sampling temperature (optional; ignored by providers that reject it)
topP - Nucleus sampling (optional)
stopSequences - Stop sequences (optional)
metadata - Free-form metadata (optional)
jsonOutput - True when the caller will parse the reply as JSON; providers with a JSON mode enable it, others rely on the prompt
public record LlmRequest(String userPrompt, String systemPrompt, String modelId, Integer maxTokens, Double temperature, Double topP, List<String> stopSequences, Map<String,Object> metadata, boolean jsonOutput) extends Record
Provider-neutral LLM invocation request.
